title: Tensor single pullback composition
statement: For schemes [def-pc-scheme] with module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] and shared derived categories [def-pc-derived-category], let $q:A\to X$, $q_1:B\to X$, $q_2:C\to X$, $a:B\to A$, $b:C\to B$, $a\prime:C\to A$ satisfy $aq=q_1$, $bq_1=q_2$, $a\prime q=q_2$ and $ba=a\prime$. Fix an $\mathcal O_X$-module $L$, and put $M=q^\otimes L$, $N=q_1^\otimes L$. For a triangle $rq=q_1$, let $d_r:r^*M\cong q_1^\otimes L$ be the inverse unique left-adjoint comparison from tensor to ordinary pullback followed by the inverse conjugate of pushforward composition and transport along the triangle [lem-pc-module-pullback-adjunction]. Define $e_a=s_a(M)\gg d_a[0]$, $e_b=s_b(N)\gg d_b[0]$ and $e_{a\prime}=s_{a\prime}(M)\gg d_{a\prime}[0]$, where $s$ is the canonical single-module derived-pullback comparison [lem-pc-canonical-single-pullback-comparison]. With $K=M[0]$ and the selected comparison $c$ [lem-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-pullback-composition], composition in Lean order obeys $Lb^*(e_a)\gg e_b=c(b,a)_K\gg\mathrm{transport}_{ba=a\prime}\gg e_{a\prime}$. No flatness or invertibility of $s$ is assumed. Each d is the fixed identification [def-sc-tensor-coefficient-comparison], whose construction is the displayed conjugate and left-adjoint uniqueness formula.

proof.text: Prove naturality of canonicalSinglePullbackMap by naturality of the selected derived counit, the single-complex comparison, and the unique tensor-to-ordinary adjunction comparison. Name the single and homotopy functors explicitly, change the equations to those named maps, and combine the three equalities by category-only reassociation. Substitute aprime=b≫a. Move d1 through the b single comparison and apply tensorCoefficientPullback_composition. Map its ordinary equality by the single functor, then combine it with canonicalSinglePullbackComposition using the category-only pasting calculation. No geometric construction is unfolded in that pasting calculation.

lean.statement: theorem tensorSinglePullback_composition {A B C X : Scheme.{v}} (q : A ⟶ X) (q1 : B ⟶ X) (q2 : C ⟶ X) (a : B ⟶ A) (b : C ⟶ B) (a' : C ⟶ A) (h1 : a ≫ q = q1) (h2 : b ≫ q1 = q2) (h3 : a' ≫ q = q2) (hab : b ≫ a = a') (L : X.Modules) : let d1 := Scheme.Modules.tensorCoefficientComparison q q1 a h1 L let d2 := Scheme.Modules.tensorCoefficientComparison q1 q2 b h2 L let d3 := Scheme.Modules.tensorCoefficientComparison q q2 a' h3 L let M := (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback q).obj L let N := (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback q1).obj L let K := (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (SheafOfModules.{v} (moduleRings A.toRingedSpace)) 0).obj M (derivedPullback b).map (Scheme.Modules.canonicalSinglePullbackMap a M ≫ (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (SheafOfModules.{v} (moduleRings B.toRingedSpace)) 0).map d1.hom) ≫ Scheme.Modules.canonicalSinglePullbackMap b N ≫ (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (SheafOfModules.{v} (moduleRings C.toRingedSpace)) 0).map d2.hom = (canonicalDerivedPullbackComposition b a ≪≫ eqToIso (congrArg (fun r ↦ derivedPullback r) hab)).hom.app K ≫ (Scheme.Modules.canonicalSinglePullbackMap a' M ≫ (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (SheafOfModules.{v} (moduleRings C.toRingedSpace)) 0).map d3.hom)
